content:
## Request Context
- **What was requested**: Implement SPEC-20260610-005602 (Layer B Phase 4 Unit 4.1 - read-only hook-health chip for the live dashboard). Supervised headless session; developer directive 2026-06-09 pre-authorizes Phases 4-5 autonomously.
- **Files/scope**: NEW src/telemetry/hooks_health.py (pure model); src/telemetry/dashboard.py (render_hook_health_chip + additive render_live_fragment param); scripts/telemetry/dashboard_server.py (public load_hook_health + /fragments/live wiring); tests/test_telemetry.py + tests/test_dashboard_server.py; regression ledger.
- **Developer-stated motivation**: SPEC-20260607-183136 R6 self-monitoring surface - gatekeeper sees at a glance whether enforcement hooks are wired.
- **Explicit constraints**: AC1/AC3 no-inject load-bearing (never execute/mutate hooks or settings.json; basename-only minimum disclosure; bounded 4KB gate-log tail read); R14 pure/transport split; ADR-0020 narrow recency labelling; statusLine intentionally excluded; NO push.

Build plan: T1 src/telemetry/hooks_health.py pure model (HookConfigParse, parse_hook_script_refs with pinned regex strategy, HookHealthReport, status constants, assess_hook_health); T2 src/telemetry/dashboard.py render_hook_health_chip + _HOOK_HEALTH_STATUS_LABEL + hook_health_chip_html param on render_live_fragment; T3 scripts/telemetry/dashboard_server.py public load_hook_health (read-only, bounded tail) + /fragments/live wiring; T4 tests per AC-U1..U7+U9 in test_telemetry.py + test_dashboard_server.py; T5 regression-ledger entry. Checkpoints: after T1 (architecture-choice trigger: new pure module contract) arch+qa; after T2+T3 (API route + user-facing render trigger) security+ux.

APPROVE (0.95). Module contract sound and spec-complete; R14 purity upheld (zero IO, stdlib-only, frozen dataclasses with tuple fields). All five spec-folded findings correctly implemented: arch F1 dataclass returns; security F1 basename-only (group(1) capture, command never propagates); qa F2 pinned module-level regex with rationale + both slash directions; qa F5 dict.setdefault first-seen dedup with hook_count from len(commands); qa F8 null/malformed tolerance via isinstance guards. INFO only: DRIFT_KINDS vs HOOK_HEALTH_STATUSES naming asymmetry - cosmetic, no action; align if a third vocabulary tuple ever lands. Strengths: honest-absence statement in module docstring where the renderer author cannot miss it; _iter_hook_commands isolates traversal; assess takes missing as resolved fact (transport does is_file work) keeping the boundary clean.

APPROVE (0.96). Parse walk verified against the LIVE settings.json: PreToolUse matcher entries, UserPromptSubmit entries WITHOUT matcher (tolerant entry.get path), both bash and powershell -File command forms all handled; statusLine sibling never touched (walk descends only into document.get(hooks)). Regex charset covers all eight real script basenames (hyphen + dot included). Spec-pinned edges all honored: hooks:null degrades via isinstance guard; first-seen-order dedup; hook_count counts ALL commands; tz-awareness responsibility correctly at transport layer per R-4.1.2. Minor: hyphen in regex class redundantly escaped - not a correctness issue. No testability problems: pure signatures take plain str|None + resolved tuples, AC-U1/U2/U3 constructible without mocks.

REVISE round 1 (0.97). Two missing-import defects (mechanical blockers, not security flaws): dashboard.py used HOOK_STATUS_* + HookHealthReport without the hooks_health import; dashboard_server.py called render_hook_health_chip / parse_hook_script_refs / assess_hook_health without importing them - NameError on the /fragments/live path. ROOT CAUSE (facilitator): the PostToolUse auto-format hook strips imports that are unused AT EDIT TIME; imports were added before their consumers in a multi-edit sequence. Security posture otherwise CLEAN on all six checks: read-only loader (no exec/write surface); basename-only disclosure via regex group; Path(ref).name re-normalization at stat site blocks traversal; bounded 4KB seek tail with OSError tolerance; _esc on every dynamic field inside the renderer; no CSP or allowlist regression; full settings content never reaches a response body.

REVISE round 1 (0.87). HIGH (WCAG 1.3.1/2.4.3): missing-script basenames were title-attribute-ONLY - unreachable for keyboard/touch users and most screen-reader browse modes, yet they are the actionable detail; remediate as visible text. MED (plain language): summary produced grammatical stutter "hook scripts scripts missing" (literal + label concatenation). Confirmed sound: chip-above-runway precondition-banner placement; recency copy honest and narrowly scoped to the quality gate; not_configured dashed-border non-judgmental absence; WCAG 1.4.1 satisfied at label-text level; _esc inside the helper.

APPROVE round 2 (0.97). Both Round-1 defects resolved: all four symbols imported in dashboard.py (incl. datetime UTC) and all four in dashboard_server.py; no NameError path remains on /fragments/live. The new visible missing-names span passes through _esc before interpolation; class-attribute status also escaped. No new concerns.

APPROVE round 2 (0.97). HIGH fold verified: missing basenames render as visible escaped text with title retained as convenience layer; amber CSS scoped correctly. MED fold verified: label map now "missing", summary reads grammatically clean "1 of 5 hook scripts missing".

Build complete: 5 tasks (T1 pure model, T2 render chip + fragment param + CSS, T3 transport loader + route wiring, T4 33 tests across two files incl. new tests/test_telemetry_hooks_health.py mirroring the test-file-per-module precedent, T5 ledger entry #45), 2 checkpoints fired (CP1 after T1: arch 0.95 + qa 0.96 double-APPROVE; CP2 after T2+T3: security + ux double-REVISE round 1 -> double-APPROVE 0.97/0.97 round 2), 0 unresolved concerns. Round-1 findings folded: missing imports (root cause: PostToolUse auto-format strips imports unused at edit time - imports re-added after consumers existed), visible missing-names text (WCAG 1.3.1), label-stutter fix. Post-checkpoint fix: dot-only traversal refs (Path('..').name == '..' not empty) skipped at the stat site, caught by the new traversal regression test. Quality gate 7/7 (45 guards; 103 server+hooks tests pass in targeted run, full suite green under gate).

## What I Missed
Traced the round-1 NameErrors as import-management failures without going upstream: the PostToolUse auto-format hook stripped imports it judged unused at edit time, before the full module context was assembled - hook-induced drift between edit state and runtime state (locally correct, globally wrong).
## Candidate Improvement Rule
When a PostToolUse hook modifies files, it must run against the full module dependency graph, not the single edited file in isolation; alternatively disable auto-removal of imports (only addition and sorting are safe in a partial-edit context).
## Confidence Calibration
Delta: -0.2 (overconfident round 1 - pattern-matched to developer-forgot-the-import instead of asking why a mature codebase would show that failure at checkpoint time).

## What I Missed
N/A in part - I RAISED the WCAG title-only finding in round 1; the reflection notes the deeper rule: read code for assistive-tech encounter paths, not just visual output, and catch copy stutters on a single read-through.
## Candidate Improvement Rule
For any chip or badge with icon-only or tooltip-only affordances, verify every informative non-text element carries a visible-text or programmatic name before approving - never rely on title alone.
## Confidence Calibration
Delta: -0.15
